newsitem.title: USA: Fair skies, mild temps for Brazil coffee - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Fair skies, mild temps for Brazil coffee - WSC.

text.p: Generally favorable conditions for the trees are expected in Brazil's coffee belt this week, Weather Services Corp said in an update on Tuesday. Last week's rains have improved soil moisture conditions prior to the normal winter dry season.
There were fair skies this morning. Temperatures ranged below normal from 39-46 F (4-8 C), however no damaging cold was observed.
According to WSC, temperatures may remain cool this week, although no damaging cold is expected.
Fair to partly cloudy skies are expected today. Partly to variably cloudy skies for Wednesday and Thrusday. Temperatures will turn milder, with lows mostly in the 50's F (low to middle teens C).
The extended outlook calls for partly cloudy skies through Sunday and the chance of a few light showers next Monday. Temperatures should be near normal. ((New York Commodity Desk 212 859-1640))
